event_text: The NZDF's website provider tells it of unauthorised access to website systems; the NZDF takes affected websites offline
notes: The notice gives the day; RNZ and the NZ Herald say Friday morning.

event_text: The NZ Herald reports the NZDF's statement that a discount-scheme database was accessed
An NZDF spokesman tells Cyber Daily the website remains offline while remediation continues
The NZDF website still shows only a temporary page about the incident
